hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); f="docs/status/$(printf %s "$b" | tr / -).md"; echo "Branch: ${b:-(detached)}. Read this branch status before acting. Decisions: grep docs/decisions/. History: grep only."; echo "=== $f"; head -n 70 "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo '(no status file for this branch yet: create it from docs/status/README.md)'; echo '=== last 5 commits'; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; true
